set: A: the two keys, whole and in native crops, and the page look sheet, each beside its approved image

issues.what: the frame is a close-up of the lower-right corner of the drop zone, with the Browse files button and text huge. The target shows the whole step 1 page at normal framing (header, progress buttons, drop zone, fields) with the arrow feeding the paper in beside the drop zone
issues.fix: use the full-page framing of the target for this beat, at the same scale as set-A-05-b, and keep the arrow and paper as one small part of the page

issues.what: the deck is a flat, dark grey, brushed slab. The target's metal is light, satin brushed steel with a bright rolled rim and soft reflections, so the keyboard reads as a dark block against the light page
issues.fix: lighten the deck to the target's pale satin steel, add a bright bevelled rim along its top edge and soft vertical highlights, and keep the dark shading only in the gaps between the keys

issues.what: the main button is dark charcoal with grey text. In the target the main button is glossy orange in a chrome bezel with light text, the one accent beside button 1
issues.fix: make the primary button the target's glossy orange (#E0602A range) with a top highlight, a thin chrome bezel ring and a soft shadow on the lower right

issues.where: the key under the arrow, between G and J
issues.what: the H key has lost its letter and shows only a blank orange glow. In the target the hit key keeps its letter and gets only a small glow and a scorch
issues.fix: keep the legend on the hit key and cut the glow to a small warm halo at the point of impact

issues.where: the arrow crop and the keys crop
issues.what: the bullet holes are bright bronze rings with sparks, and the arrow is small, thin-edged and tinted orange by the glow. In the target the holes are charred black scorch marks with sooty edges and a wisp of smoke, and the arrow is a glossy white body with a thick dark outline and a scorch mark on it
issues.fix: redraw the holes as dark char with a soft brown burn falloff and thin smoke, and keep the arrow white and glossy with a heavy dark edge and its own drop shadow, with no orange tint over the body

issues.what: the barrel is short and level, and the bolt sits on top of the Caps Lock legend and hides it. The target's turret is a polished chrome dome with a long tapered barrel at an angle, a bright orange muzzle glow and a thin glowing tracer above the keys
issues.fix: lengthen and taper the barrel, aim it up toward the keys, add the hot orange tip, and draw the bolts as thin tracers with a soft trail that travel above the legends

issues.what: the keycaps are a saturated butter-yellow with soft, puffy sides. The target's caps are pale ivory with crisp, sculpted tops and a cool grey shadow
issues.fix: move the keycap colour toward a neutral ivory (less yellow), tighten the top edge highlight and give each cap a short, crisp shadow

issues.what: the arrow is grey chrome with blurry grey shading, and the arms are flat black outlines with small hands. In the target the arrow is a glossy white ceramic body with a thick black edge, and the arms are round black rubber tubes with modelled gloved hands that cast shadows
issues.fix: make the arrow body white with a glossy top highlight and a heavy dark edge, give the arms round tube shading and specular highlights, and enlarge the hands with knuckle detail and a soft shadow on the glass

issues.where: the page surface in every crop
issues.what: the page grain is a coarse, even noise like stucco. The target's page is a fine paper with a faint fibrous grain
issues.fix: cut the grain contrast by about half and use a finer, fibrous paper texture

issues.what: the drop zone is a raised frame around a deeper inner well, darker and greyer, and the fields have dark, heavy rims. The target's drop zone is one pale frosted-glass plate with a bright edge, and its fields are shallow pale glass troughs with light rims
issues.fix: flatten the drop zone into one frosted glass plate with a bright bevel and a dashed inset line, lighten the glass, and thin and lighten the field rims

issues.what: the page is greyer and darker, and the shadows under the progress buttons, drop zone and fields are dark and hard on the lower right. The target is brighter ivory-white with long, soft, faint shadows
issues.fix: raise the page brightness toward the target's warm white, and make the shadows longer, softer and lighter

issues.where: progress button 1 and the metal buttons, upper right
issues.what: button 1 is a dark red-brown, and the steel buttons are dark, heavily domed chrome with black shadows. The target's button 1 is a bright, glossy orange, and its steel buttons are lighter satin metal
issues.fix: brighten button 1 to the target's orange, and lighten the steel buttons toward satin with a softer shadow

issues.what: the focus glow on First name is yellow-amber and spread wide. The target's glow is a thin, bright orange line with a tight bloom
issues.fix: shift the hue toward orange and tighten the bloom radius

issues.what: the paper is a flat sheet going into a raised chrome shredder that drops strips onto the page. The target feeds a crumpled, lined sheet into a dark slot cut into the page
issues.fix: give the sheet folds and soft shading, and set the feed into a dark slot in the page surface with a lip shadow
